caseName: Southern Pacific Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: SOUTHERN PACIFIC COMPANY v. United States

opinions.text:
Transportation of military equipment under the Transportation Act of 1940 for use by the Army of the Republic of China in compliance with the Lend-Lease Program. Petitions dismissed.

Plaintiff’s petitions for writs of certiorari denied by the Supreme Court March 10, 1947.
